description: Measure Qwen3-4B on an L4 before the thinking-on training run: full no-thinking baseline (315 held-out words, the 'before thinking' reference), a thinking baseline on 16 words (tokens per game, win rate), and one thinking GRPO step (time and memory). Thinking items are small: on an L4 only ~3 thinking games fit in the KV cache at once.
